title: M-theory and T-geometry: Higgs branch moduli and charged matter
summary: M-theory geometric engineering on manifolds of special holonomy yields a rich class of novel field theories. In this paper, we construct new 3d $\mathcal{N}=2^{\ast}$ and $\mathcal{N}=4^{\ast}$ gauge theories, realized as mass-deformations of theories with 16 supercharges, within this framework. These arise from non-compact 8d geometries given by fibrations of $\mathbb{R}^{4}/Γ_{ADE}$ over Biberbach 4-manifolds.
